ticket.summary: Proactive replacement of 14-year-old 40-gal gas water heater; no leak or emergency, customer booked Sept 2 10:30 AM.

quote_lines.description: 40-gal gas water heater replacement, incl. unit, gas/water reconnection, flex kit, T&P discharge, old tank haul-away
City permit + inspection, billed at cost (~$50-150, not included in total)

ticket.customer_message: Good question - the $1,450 covers the new 40-gallon tank, reconnecting the existing gas line and water lines, a new flex connector kit, drip leg/sediment trap, T&P valve and discharge pipe, plus disposal of the old unit. Beyond that and the permit fee, the only things that would ever add cost are code upgrades we can't reuse - e.g. a corroded gas shutoff, an undersized or non-compliant vent, or adding an expansion tank if your system needs one (~$180). The tech will flag anything like that with a price before touching a wrench. One correction on scheduling: our 8 AM slots are held for emergency/urgent calls, so let's put you in Sept 2 at 10:30 AM - a full 4-hour block, perfect for this job. You're booked. Please clear a path to the heater and text this number anytime if anything changes.
